name: Those Who Are Against Israel
overview: Scripture reveals God's sovereign blessing upon Israel, promising to make them a great nation and a source of blessing to all families of the earth, while warning that those who oppose Israel will face His curse. The psalmist calls on God not to remain silent in the face of threats against Israel, urging believers to pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Furthermore, Isaiah highlights God's future gathering of Israel's dispersed people, affirming His ongoing commitment to restore and protect His chosen nation.
